a convolutional layer with band-pass filter kernels is a promising input layer for CNN-based classification tasks on audio signals, and that this approach enables a reduction in the amount of training parameters, an improvement of the classification performance, and a better understanding and interpretation of the data.

a new convolutional filter-bank layer can be designed, that it can achieve state-ofthe-art accuracy on several tasks, that it can enable larger kernel sizes, that it can provide additional interpretability, and that it can be used as the input layer for CNN-based acoustic applications.
